g.text: Use 9-pin 10k bussed resistor networks (one per chip).

g.text: Encoder push switches and lever switches are inputs too.

g.text: Spare inputs keep their 10k pull-up (never leave floating).

g.text: Labels and 5 mm status LEDs are all on the WS2812B line (03).
